**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No non-solicitation, no-poach, or no-hire covenant exists anywhere in this APCN 2 agreement. Targeted searches for *solicit, employ, employees, personnel, staff, recruit, engage, induce, hire,* and *restrictive covenant* returned zero hits, and the full section outline (Paragraphs 1–35 plus the Segment S/Terminal Party schedules) contains no restrictive-covenant provision. Paragraph 21.1 reinforces this by limiting the common enterprise among the Parties "to the express provisions of this Agreement."

Because the playbook's preferred position for NOSOLICIT is simply that Customer bears no non-solicitation restriction, the absence of any such covenant satisfies the rule outright — no redline proposed, and nothing to negotiate down to the fallback.
